research.notes: Website does not name OUSD schools specifically; identity rests on registry name/EIN match, Oakland location, and K-12 school programs. Legal name per ProPublica is 'Artogether' (stylized ARTogether on its website). CA entity number and SAM UEI not looked up.

profile.summary: ARTogether is an Oakland-based nonprofit that runs art programs for refugees and immigrants. Its programs include therapeutic arts and wellness workshops, arts programs in K-12 schools, mentorship and funding for artists, public arts projects and media projects.

review.notes: ARTogether is an Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 82-3045350) whose site and ProPublica record match the profile; its Arts in Schools program for newcomer students and its summer art camps fit OUSD's contracts (including Oakland International High School), though the site does not name OUSD schools. Summary and contact fields are supported, neutral, and use only a generic business email.
